question: International Labour Day 2025 was celebrated globally on which of the following dates?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fri May 01 2026 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **International Labour Day**, also known as **May Day**, is celebrated annually on **May 1st** across the globe to honor the contributions of workers and the labor movement.
 
• The first May Day was celebrated in **1889** after the establishment of the International Socialist Congress in Paris to commemorate the **Haymarket affair of 1886**.
 
• **Fri May 01 2026** is the accurate date for International Labour Day in 2026 as it aligns with the annual observation of the day on **May 1st**.
 
• International Labour Day symbolizes the struggle for **fair labor practices, rights, and better working conditions** for workers worldwide.
 
• It is recognized as a public holiday in many countries, including **India**, where workers participate in various events such as rallies, marches, and discussions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of International Labour Day:**

 
 
• International Labour Day originated from the labor union movement advocating for an **eight-hour workday**.
 
• The **Haymarket affair**, a major labor protest in Chicago in **1886**, played a pivotal role in establishing May 1st as Labour Day.
 
• The day became internationally recognized after the **Second International** declared May 1st as International Workers' Day in **1889**.
 
 
 
• **Significance:**
 
 
• Labour Day serves as a reminder of the **struggles and achievements** of workers over the years.
 
• It highlights the importance of ensuring **fair wages, safe working conditions, and social protections**.
 
• It is a day to express solidarity with workers globally and promote **economic equality**.
 
 
 
• **Observance in India:**
 
 
• Labour Day was first celebrated in **India** on **May 1, 1923**, in **Chennai** by the **Labour Kisan Party of Hindustan**.
 
• It is a public holiday in several states, with workers' unions organizing rallies, speeches, and cultural events.
 
• The day is an opportunity to acknowledge the vital contributions of workers in India's economic progress.
 
 
 
• **Global Observance:**
 
 
• Many countries, including the **United States, United Kingdom, and Australia**, observe Labour Day but on different dates due to historical and cultural differences.
 
• In some countries, such as **China, Russia, and Germany**, May Day is a significant national holiday with parades and celebrations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Haymarket Affair:**

 
 
• The **Haymarket Affair** was a labor protest in Chicago in **May 1886** that turned violent, leading to several deaths and inspiring the global labor movement.
 
• It emphasized the need for **workers' rights** and became the cornerstone for observing May Day.
 
 
 
• **International Labour Organization (ILO):**
 
 
• The ILO, established in **1919**, plays a crucial role in promoting **global labor standards**.
 
• It advocates for **decent work conditions, fair wages, and employment opportunities** worldwide.
 
• ILO conventions and recommendations guide nations in improving labor practices.
 
 
 
• **Modern-day Observance:**
 
 
• Labour Day is marked by **rallies, speeches, and demonstrations** to address labor-related issues.
 
• It serves as a platform for workers to voice their concerns regarding **employment, wages, and workplace safety**.
 
• Educational institutions and organizations use the day to raise awareness about the **rights and responsibilities** of workers.
